league.name: bots-v1
league.description: The four precons that have a shipped playbook on 2026-11-11 (Goblin Storm, Token Triumph, Hail, Caesar, Tricky Terrain), as one table: a league of the bot decks alone, to see how the bots play each other. Played with league.py play --playbooks every seat is under its playbook; without it the same table is all stock. If this list ever changes (a fifth bot), that is a new league with a new name.
